source_description: Fix GitHub issue #253 — felix-admin-capture (haiku 4.5) skipped Step 6.2 (marker injection) on a parse_failure during the mission #185 canary on 2026-05-12, fabricating a 'script not found' excuse. Root cause is structural: multi-step bash recipes inside agent prompts are fragile to model variance. Step 5a has the same shape and the same latent fragility. This mission consolidates both Step 5a and Step 6 into single-call helpers, applying the deterministic-work-into-scripts principle.
